## About
MarblePro is a specialist stone-care company serving all 7 UAE emirates. We restore
marble, terrazzo, granite, quartz and Corian surfaces using diamond grinding (50–3000
grit) and genuine Italian crystallization, backed by a written gloss guarantee
(minimum 85 GU). Dust-free wet process, fixed-price quotes, same-week availability.
